feature_plan.quantization: Exact rational -> ties-to-even -> INT8 [-127,127]; normalized values times127, zero for zero denominator; new output ranges analytical, no validation fitted scales
feature_plan.low_points: N=1 dispersion/contrast=0; N=2 range-normalized variance hits maximum if nonzero span; this degeneracy is disclosed and separately evaluated
feature_plan.physical_scope: Near-zero radial speed does NOT prove stationary object; normalized covariance is NOT Pearson correlation or rotation invariant; history-fused distribution is NOT instantaneous object shape

definitions.support: 1/N, quantized as round_even(127/N); N is full retained input including history, not current raw count
definitions.quantiles: For sorted int16 a and k=1,2,3, j=floor(k*(N-1)/4), r=k*(N-1)%4: Qk_times4=(4-r)*a[j]+r*a[min(j+1,N-1)]
definitions.range: support/width in [0,1], asymmetry/median_position in [-1,1]; multiply127, ties-to-even

feature_plan.cost: Quantile families need four channel sorts plus linear copies, not a single scan; reused quantiles feed all three groups; no FPGA inference

input: 1..511 points, little endian int16 [x,y,compensated radial velocity,RCS], Q8.8; upstream same-sequence/sensor/GT-track history; sparse observations do not update history
history: Same sequence/sensor/GT track; current plus preceding six retained observations; sparse observations do not update history; no coordinate alignment or time expiry
output: class0 labels7/8; class1 labels0/1/2/3; tie chooses0
scope: Software candidate reference; no board measurement or deployment promotion
integer_weights: all INT8, biases INT32; ties-to-even and ReLU saturation127
